deleteAccount.title: Delete your LevApp account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your LevApp account at any time. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.inAppSteps: Open Settings → Account → Delete account and confirm. The account is deleted at once and you are signed out on every device.
deleteAccount.emailAfter: from the address on your account, or tell us the account's username. We confirm by email and delete the account within 30 days.
deleteAccount.deletedIdentity: Your name, email, phone, username and password.
deleteAccount.deletedDetails: Your date of birth, country and profile photo.
deleteAccount.deletedSessions: Your sign-in on every device and your registrations for notifications.
deleteAccount.deletedClasses: Your place in every upcoming class and waiting list.
deleteAccount.deletedCrm: For coaches, your contact in our customer records.
deleteAccount.keptCoachRecords: Your coach's record of the classes you already took — attendance, evaluations and notes — and the messages you sent, shown as "Deleted user".
deleteAccount.keptBackups: Copies in backups, for a limited period, until they are overwritten.
deleteAccount.keptLegal: What the law requires us to keep, or what we need for security or to establish or defend legal claims.
